top_signals.title: European Bond Selloff Deepens as ECB Flags Inflationary Risks
top_signals.summary: A selloff in European bonds extended after European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde flagged risks to inflation, adding to investors’ ongoing concerns about elevated energy prices.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Russia sends bones of medieval warrior prince to Ukraine front to boost morale
top_signals.summary: Bone fragments from the sword hand of a medieval Russian prince who won a famous victory over the Mongols have been sent to the front in Ukraine.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
